creativeThesis: Follow the ball as unusual rules reverse what each team needs to do.
viewerExperience: An irrational own goal becomes rational, then Grenada gains two possible scoring targets; Barbados protects both until the extra-time resolution.
emotionalTarget: Amused disbelief resolving into precise understanding of a documented incentive reversal.
visualThesis: A labeled original pitch reconstruction follows the ball, separates hypothetical outcomes and returns to the actual tied match. No invented match footage, formations or official-looking reconstructed broadcast.

risks: Original illustration is not actual match footage.
Player positions, trajectories and symbolic colors are explanatory, not documented formations or kits.
The first change from 2–0 to 2–1 does not identify the scorer; contemporary and later accounts conflict.
Counterfactual scores are labeled and separated from actual sequence.
Weighted extra-time qualification margin is distinguished from physical goals scored.
No exact match date, player quote, goal minute, FIFA ruling or abolition claim in the master.

provenance.notes: Actual recent contact-sheet inspection and source-bound editorial judgments. No owner master or publication approval.
